title: Gatineau Park Nocturnal Hike and Dinner From Ottawa
includes: Experienced and local guide for the duration of the tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Experience the second most visited park in Canada like never before with this starlight adventure. Join Aventure Outaouais for an awesome guided hiking adventure in the Gatineau Park to a beautiful wood cabin at night where a nice warm dinner will be prepared by your guide on the wood stove and served in the warmth and the tranquility of a beautiful wood cabin. Discover the Gatineau Park while it comes alive at night.

The journey itself is considered easy to moderate in difficulty with roughly 6 km (round-trip) in length. With the help of a trained and experienced guide, you will be assisted through this fun adventure and given lots of pro tips. We provide all the training and equipment to make it to the shelter and back. This round-trip should take around 3 hours to complete, including 1 hour to rest and eat at the shelter.
